description: Writes the business's words into the setup (name, what it is, who it's for, offerings, pricing, voice and the rest of get_setup's answers_fields), its colours and its headline and body fonts. Write as much as each answer needs. Call again to change one; an answer sent empty clears the one on file. Fill name and description first: the project that holds files is made from them. A font family Marsell doesn't ship is fetched from Google Fonts when Google has it; otherwise send its file with add_font.

audience.description: Who buys it, as specifically as you know: the people or businesses, their situation.

availability.description: What is available now and what is coming.

avoid.description: Claims, words and framings to leave out: anything untrue, legal limits, lines on its site that undersell it.

businessModel.description: How it makes money (subscriptions, one-off sales, retainers, ads).

capacity.description: How much work it can take on, when it sells a service.

companyProductRelationship.description: How the company and its products relate (a studio with two apps, a shop under a parent brand).

competitors.description: The alternatives its buyers compare it with, by name (each with its site: add_rivals).

crm.description: Where its customer data lives (the CRM or the spreadsheet).

currentOfferings.description: What a customer can buy today, each with its price when you know it.

description.description: What it sells or does, plainly. Name its products.

features.description: What the product does that matters to a buyer.

geography.description: Where it sells, and in which languages.

history.description: When and how it started, and what changed since.

inventory.description: Its catalogue and stock, when it sells things.

name.description: The business's name, as it writes it.

pricing.description: Its prices and plans, exactly as it charges them.

products.description: Its products, by name, with what each does (the catalogue itself: add_products).

services.description: Its services, by name, with what each includes.

suppliers.description: Who makes or supplies what it sells.

tagline.description: Its brand line, exactly as it writes it.

voice.description: How it should sound when it sells: tone, the words it uses, what it never says. Lead with what the buyer gets.

display_font.description: The headline font's family. Bricolage Grotesque, DM Sans, Geist, Geist Mono ship with Marsell.

palette.description: Every brand colour, the main one first.

name.description: The colour's name, as the brand calls it.

name: fill_setup
title: Fill in the business's words
